pages.title: Passive Reactors
pages.text: A passive reactor outputs the energy it generates directly as RF, which can be used by any machine that accepts Forge Energy.$(br2)This is the simplest reactor to build and run: fuel goes in, power comes out, no fluids involved.

pages.title: Power Tap
pages.text: Where you extract power from a passive reactor. Place it on any wall, floor or ceiling face and connect a cable or a machine to the outside.$(br2)Taps show whether they are connected to something in their model. More taps mean more throughput, so a big reactor usually wants several.

pages.title: Buffer
pages.text: The reactor stores the RF it makes in an internal buffer. If the buffer fills up because nothing is drawing power, the reactor throttles itself and stops burning fuel.$(br2)That means an idle passive reactor costs you nothing. There is no need to gate it with redstone unless you want to.
